name: agentic-sdd
description: Agentic SDD in two editions: hook-free (Claude Code and Codex) and guarded (Claude Code hooks).

plugins.name: agentic-sdd
plugins.description: Spec Kit delivery driven to the Final Goal: phase contracts, a one-page phase card, a completion gate script, REA closeout, a local dashboard and tracking reports. Hook-free edition: safe where plugin hooks are blocked.

plugins.name: agentic-sdd-guarded
plugins.description: Spec Kit delivery driven to the Final Goal: phase contracts, a one-page phase card, a completion gate script, REA closeout, a local dashboard and tracking reports. Guarded edition: hooks block a false 'Final Goal met', ScheduleWakeup during a run, and log subagent spawns.
